title: Reflect the approved roadmap into DEVELOPMENT_PLAN, README, AGENTS and the task index
spec:
Objective: after docs/decisions/PROGRAM_ROADMAP_20260930.md takes effect, reflect it the way docs/decisions/PROGRAM_DECISIONS_20260928.md was reflected (its header lines 3-4): docs/DEVELOPMENT_PLAN.md header, §1, §5, §17 and §18; root README.md §3-§4 and a pointer to docs/DEVELOPMENT_PLAN.md §18 (docs/decisions/TOKEN_LAYER_AND_RIGHTS_SCALE_SCOPE_20260929.md line ~187); the docs/README.md index (add the roadmap next to the D-1~D-3 and TL/RS decision entries); docs/tasks/README.md row that still says Waves 6-7 are not started; the docs/decisions/TOKEN_LAYER_AND_RIGHTS_SCALE_SCOPE_20260929.md header status (approved by the #79 merge 5cf4168). AGENTS.md is out of scope for this node (node agents-scope-sync).
Constraints: do not change any decision; historical documents and evidence are not rewritten (AGENTS.md); README.md is a full-CI path.
Acceptance: the listed documents agree with the roadmap; checks green.
Common rules: follow AGENTS.md (program mode) and docs/decisions/PROGRAM_ROADMAP_20260930.md. Keep the two locked kernel blobs (AGENTS.md §4) and reference/v0.3-rc1/** unchanged unless this node says otherwise. The locks and unlock conditions in docs/decisions/PROGRAM_DECISIONS_20260928.md §5 still hold: no real funds, real PG/bank/KYC calls, public endpoints, Sui testnet or mainnet, R2 or own replication/consensus/storage engine, and no new coin/TIX module (the only exception is the localnet package of node tl-2, and only after the User merges tl-coin-lock-adr following the Astra re-ruling). Do not invent SLOs or product policy values: product policy values and new protocol commands go to DECISION_REQUIRED · Astra; values that need legal, tax, accounting or provider answers stay UNDETERMINED with the owner named. Do not edit CI to make the task pass. Evidence per AGENTS.md §14; protocol and kernel checks green at the exact head.
Adopted evolution follow-up: when this candidate is separately adopted, update current plan/index/status pointers and counts from this immutable plan, including active 67/pending 1 protocol and active 10/pending 20 commerce. Keep historical decisions and their original evidence/counts unchanged; link the new candidate adoption instead of rewriting history.
